

# Conclusions {#sec-discussion}



## What SSNAC offers

-   Data model: Person-Place Graph
-   Spatial & Social Descriptive Analysis
    -   Movement matrix
    -   Mixing matrix
    -   Spatial concentration graph
-   A causal inference framework
    -   DANG
        -   representation of networked causal system
        -   statistical model for observed data
    -   SWING
        -   representation of an intervention on a networked causal
            system
        -   statistical model for counterfactual data
    -   Causal Model Assumptions
        -   Independence Assumptions
            -   No Spillover
            -   Networked interference
        -   Homogeneity Assumptions
            -   Homogenous interference
                -   Separability
                -   Equivalency
                -   Symmetry
                -   Boundedness
                -   Identical distribution
